analysis.title: Helmerich & Payne Inc. (HP): 4FQ26 First Take: Stronger EBITDA on Margins, Though FY27 International Rig Guide Softer vs GS
key_insights: HP 4FQ26 adj. EBITDA of $269 mil was 4% above the GS estimate of $259 mil and 3% above FactSet consensus of $260 mil. Revenue was $1,092 mil (+1% vs GS, +2% vs consensus) and EBITDA margin was 24.6% (+59 bps vs GS 24.0%).
Revenue upside vs GS came from International Solutions (+7%) and Offshore Solutions (+6%). North America Solutions was in line with GS.
North America Solutions rig margin per day was about $18.7k vs GS $18.4k, on lower cost per rig partly offset by slightly lower revenue per rig. Average working rigs were 151, in line with GS.
International rig margin per day was about $6.9k vs GS $7.2k. The shortfall came from higher cost per rig, partly offset by higher revenue per rig.
1FQ27 North America direct margin guide is $265-275 mil vs GS $256 mil and consensus $259 mil, with an average of 148-152 rigs vs GS 152.
FY27 International Solutions average rig count guide is 50-60 vs GS 71, the main negative vs GS in the guidance. North America FY27 rig guide is 145-155 vs GS 155.
FY27 depreciation is guided to about $600 mil vs GS $612 mil and consensus $725 mil. R&D is guided to about $25 mil vs GS $32 mil and consensus $31 mil.
FY27 gross capex is guided to $320-360 mil vs GS $309 mil. G&A is guided to $255-275 mil vs GS $268 mil and consensus $271 mil. Cash taxes are guided to $180-220 mil.

GS rates HP Neutral with a 12-month price target of $41 vs a $35.15 close on 18 Nov 2026 (16.6% upside). The target averages values implied by a 5.0x through-cycle EV/EBITDA and a 13.0% through-cycle FCF yield.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps Neutral and a $41 target after an EBITDA beat on margins. The FY27 International rig guide of 50-60 is well below GS's 71.

earnings_insights: HP 4FQ26 adj. EBITDA reported $269 mil vs GS estimate $259 mil and FactSet consensus $260 mil.
HP 4FQ26 revenue reported $1,092 mil vs GS estimate $1,080 mil. Adjusted diluted EPS reported $0.36 vs GS estimate $0.25.
1FQ27 guidance: North America direct margins $265-275 mil (GS $256 mil, consensus $259 mil), international direct margins $35-55 mil (GS $44 mil), offshore direct margins $28-32 mil (GS $31 mil).
1FQ27 rig guidance: North America 148-152 rigs (GS 152), International 55-65 rigs, Offshore 30-35 contracts and contracted platform rigs.
FY27 guidance: North America 145-155 rigs (GS 155), International 50-60 rigs (GS 71), Offshore direct margins $105-125 mil on 25-35 contracts and platform rigs.
risk_factors: Upside or downside to activity levels.
